workspaceTrash.archiveFailed: Archive did not complete: {error}. The workspace may already be in Trash. Retry to finish stopping it.
workspaceTrash.archiveIntro: Move an unused workspace to the Organization's Trash. Its records and files are kept for restore.
workspaceTrash.consequences: This immediately cancels unfinished runs, ends human takeover, denies pending approvals, stops triggers and stops this workspace’s computer.
workspaceTrash.denied: Only an Organization Owner or Admin can view Workspace Trash or restore workspaces.
workspaceTrash.empty: No archived workspaces in this Organization.
workspaceTrash.intro: Archived workspaces in this Organization. Records and files stay until explicitly deleted; there is no automatic purge.
workspaceTrash.restoreNote: Restoring makes the workspace available again. Cancelled runs and denied approvals do not resume; missed messages and schedules are not replayed.
workspaceTrash.retained: Chats, history, files and browser data are retained. Trash has no automatic deletion.
workspaceTrash.title: Workspace Trash
